limitations: All scores are provisional browser judgments from the supplied screenshots, chronological still-frame filmstrips and reported runtime results; I did not independently execute the tests or watch a video.
Normal, enlarged, transition and corresponding repeated variants are grouped under their named screen/state entries; transition quality contributes to surface scores.
Compute A and F as the means of their applicable three dimensions and overall as 0.4A + 0.6F rounded to one decimal; null denotes genuinely inapplicable dimensions.
The browser threshold is not met: multiple screens and components remain below A=9, particularly dense reading details, Sky surfaces, plans and scene transitions.

No hard-gate failure is established by this evidence; content outside a captured viewport is not treated as unreachable when the supplied browser evidence reports successful scrolling and action access.
Physical iPhone/VoiceOver, native keyboard, tilt, haptics, OS sharing, notifications and native performance remain deferred and do not cause deductions by themselves.
Billing and navigator.share are simulated, connected Circles behavior is unavailable, and fixtures do not establish model quality or predictive accuracy.
The filmstrips demonstrate sampled crossfades and foreground continuity, not independent painted parallax or frame rate; performance judgments rely on the separate reported timing measurements.
Destination-specific target/focus evidence and repeated novice usability evidence are not supplied at the same specificity as the principal form and recovery controls.
topFixes: Restructure long centered explanations and sources into shorter semantic groups; reduce oversized uppercase publisher blocks.
Integrate the Sky selector, repeated wood planks and tall parchment surfaces more convincingly with the painted room.
Reduce architectural double exposure during room transitions and replace the golden orb's flat outline with scene-consistent lighting.
Compact enlarged disclosure, plan and check-in layouts so task controls compete less with introductory text.
Clarify internal scrolling in long inputs and fallback URLs, with enough inset to avoid visibly clipped glyphs.
Provide direct browser target/focus evidence for the small room destinations and representative novice-use evidence before treating the experience as effortless.
